recommendedTextbook.title: Junior Secondary Agricultural Science for Nigerian Schools Book 2
recommendedTextbook.author: Anthony Youdeowei, S. O. Ayanlaja, C. C. Agwubike
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Classification and Anatomy of Farm Animals
subtopics: Ruminants (cattle, sheep, goats) vs non-ruminants (pigs, poultry, rabbits)
Digestive system of ruminants: Rumen, reticulum, omasum, abomasum
Monogastric digestive tract and nutrient absorption
objectives: Classify farm animals based on digestive anatomy
Diagram and label the 4 stomach chambers of ruminants
Trace the pathway of ingested grass through a goat's stomach

topics.topic: Farm Animal Feeds, Feeding and Nutrition
subtopics: Classification of animal feeds: Concentrates, roughages, supplements, additives
Nutrient classes: Proteins, carbohydrates, fats, minerals, vitamins, water
Balanced ration formulation for broilers and layers
objectives: Distinguish concentrates from succulent and dry roughages
State deficiency symptoms of calcium and vitamin A in livestock
Formulate a balanced broiler starter ration using local ingredients

topics.topic: Crop Propagation: Sexual and Asexual Methods
subtopics: Sexual propagation through seeds and seed viability testing
Asexual (vegetative) propagation: Cuttings, grafting, budding, layering, suckers
Nursery practices: Bed preparation, shading, watering, hardening off
objectives: Compare sexual and asexual plant propagation
Demonstrate T-budding and stem cuttings of cassava and citrus
Describe nursery bed management from seedbed to field transplanting

subtopics: Storage structures: Silos, cribs, barns, rhumbus
Production structures: Poultry battery cages, pig pens, fish ponds
Processing structures: Cassava grating shed, feed mills
objectives: Identify 5 major types of farm storage facilities
Explain construction requirements for a standard modern pig pen
Select appropriate building materials for tropical farm structures
